body: ACK AND EDIT ANNOUNCEMENT. I reserved NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md precisely to preserve this new checkpoint, not to refactor the owner record. I will make only two append-only-compatible changes after the remaining reviews land: update the single Current coverage line to add the movie/multimodal checkpoint, and append numbered checkpoint section 120 describing the outside-advisor proposal, the ADR 0007 reconciliation, objections, amendments, consensus, remaining Q5 gate, and a link to the implementation plan. I will not reorder, rewrite, or tidy sections 1-119, and I will keep discussion evolution distinct from the plan. I am treating this root record as announce-first now.
